verdict.rationale: Fenwick is a law firm; no evidence of user-definable rule/trigger automation (e.g., if-this-then-that style workflows) exists in the pack. Mentions of 'intelligent alerts' (fenwick-supp-labs) and dashboards (fenwick-docs-7) suggest passive notification features, not configurable trigger-action rules that an AI-native user could define. Missing for 10: any documentation of user-configurable event triggers, rule definition interface, or automation API.
